751-3499-3755.description:
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
When Shrieking Drake enters, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shrieking Drake by tapping it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Shrieking Drake ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

3899-6662-7084.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Chocobo Racetrack triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

2738-4871-4976-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Open the Graves, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Open the Graves trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability from step 1.
Repeat.

801-2292-5220-7855.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Impulsive Pilferer
When Impulsive Pilferer dies, it, The Great Goblin's second ability and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Impulsive Pilferer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Impulsive Pilferer onto the top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Great Goblin trigger, exiling Impulsive Pilferer from the top of your library with the ability to play it until the end of your next turn.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Cast Impulsive Pilferer from exile by paying {R}.
Repeat

2438-3490-4455-7426.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
2438-3490-4455-7426.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Ghost Lantern triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta and Animation Module trigger.
Resolve the Berta trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat

719-1399-1606-6984.notablePrerequisites:
Evendo has at least twelve charge counters on it.
You control three or more creatures.
719-1399-1606-6984.description:
Activate Evendo by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Evendo.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat.

1129-1978-3263.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Allies.
1129-1978-3263.description:
Activate Harabaz Druid by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Harabaz Druid.
Repeat

560-5189-5641.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
560-5189-5641.description:
Activate Ghave's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing another creature, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn and a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

3438-3470-5702.notablePrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
3438-3470-5702.description:
Activate Inkmoth Nexus's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Inkmoth Nexus's second ability by paying {1}, causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to Inkmoth Nexus.
Play any land.
When the land enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko and Lotus Cobra trigger.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Inkmoth Nexus.
When the Inkmoth Nexus token enters the battlefield, Lotus Cobra and Springheart Nantuko trigger.
Holding priority, activate the Inkmoth Nexus token's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}.
Repeat from step 6.

2011-2972-4711.notablePrerequisites:
Najeela and Ganax do not have summoning sickness.
You have at least three opponents.
An opponent cannot block and kill Ganax or Najeela.
2011-2972-4711.description:
Declare Ganax and Najeela as attackers.
Ganax's myriad ability triggers, as well as Najeela's first and myriad abilities.
Resolve the first Najeela trigger, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token that is tapped and attacking.
Resolve the Najeela myriad trigger, creating a token copy of it tapped and attacking each other opponent.
Put all Najeela tokens into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Resolve the Ganax trigger, creating at least two token copies of it tapped and attacking each other opponent.
Put all Ganax tokens into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Ganax tokens enter the battlefield, triggering each Ganax a number of times equal to the number of tokens created.
Resolve all Ganax triggers, creating at least six Treasure tokens.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat.

232-586-1980-2556-2596.description:
Cast Living Death by paying {3}{B}{B}.
Swarm Intelligence triggers, copying Living Death.
Resolve the copy of Living Death, exiling all creature cards in all graveyards, then causing each player to sacrifice all creatures they control, then putting all creatures exiled this way onto the battlefield.
Resolve Living Death, exiling all creature cards in all graveyards, then causing each player to sacrifice all creatures they control, then putting all creatures exiled this way onto the battlefield.
Mnemonic Wall, Priest of Gix, and Priest of Urabrask enter the battlefield, triggering their abilities.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Mnemonic Wall trigger, returning Living Death from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1472-4050-4124-4871.notablePrerequisites: You do not control a Keimi token.
1472-4050-4124-4871.description:
Cast Whip Silk by paying {G}, targeting Tatsunari.
Tatsunari triggers, creating a 3/3 Keimi creature token.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Keimi, adding {G}.
When Keimi dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Whip Silk by paying {G}, returning it to your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Repeat.

541-1367-3634-3879.description:
Cast Nexus of Fate by paying {5}{U}{U}, granting you an extra turn after this one and exiling it due to rebound.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, rebound triggers, causing you to cast the exiled spell without paying its mana cost.
Activate Portal of Sanctuary by tapping it and paying {1}, returning Venser to your hand.
Cast Venser by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Venser enters the battlefield, they trigger, returning the extra turn spell to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

2104-2665-4477.notablePrerequisites:
Enough mana available to cast the extra turn spell each turn.
Progenitor Mimic is a copy of Greenwarden of Murasa.
2104-2665-4477.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Progenitor Mimic triggers, creating a token copy of Greenwarden of Murasa.
When the token Greenwarden of Murasa enters the battlefield, it triggers itself, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2493-3395-4377.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {4}{U}{U}, taking an extra turn after this one.
Cast Archaeomancer by paying {2}{U}{U}.
Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, returning Walk the Aeons to your hand.
Activate Crystal Shard by paying {U} and tapping it, returning Archaeomancer to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Repeat.
